feed.title: All In On McDonald's Stock? Social Media User Wants Advice on Fast Food Giant, Investors Aren't Lovin' It
feed.summary: A social media user, Nik Hulewsky, sought advice on whether to invest his entire net worth in McDonald's (NYSE: MCD) stock, citing a 3.3% dividend yield and perceived low valuation. feed.title: Biogen's experimental lupus drug shows benefit against skin symptoms
feed.summary: Biogen announced that its experimental drug, litifilimab, demonstrated durable improvement in skin symptoms for patients with cutaneous lupus erythematosus (CLE) in a mid-stage study. The drug, which targets BDCA2 receptors to suppress inflammation, showed that 27.2% of participants achieved clear or almost clear skin after one year, with no new safety concerns identified. These results are crucial for Biogen as it seeks to diversify its product portfolio amidst challenges to its multiple sclerosis treatments.

feed.title: Prediction: This Nuclear Stock Outperforms Oklo and NuScale Through 2030 (Hint: It Already Has Revenue)
feed.summary: BWX Technologies (BWXT) is predicted to outperform nuclear energy companies like Oklo and NuScale through 2030 because it already has significant revenue streams, unlike its peers who are still in early commercialization stages. BWXT generated $3.2 billion in revenue in 2025 and is projected to reach $3.8 billion in 2026, driven by its established business of manufacturing nuclear components for the U.S. Navy, developing advanced nuclear reactors and microreactors, and producing TRISO fuel and medical isotopes. This existing revenue and diversified involvement in the nuclear market positions BWXT for continued growth without relying solely on the successful commercialization of new reactor designs.

feed.title: Pursuit proposes 3,000+ foot-long tram taking people to the top of Columbia Mountain
feed.summary: Pursuit Attractions and Hospitality, Inc. has proposed building a 3,000+ foot-long tram, the Glacier View Tram, in the Flathead National Forest to transport visitors up Columbia Mountain near Glacier National Park. The year-round sightseeing experience would feature two 100-passenger cabins and would be privately financed, estimated to support 230 jobs. This is Pursuit's second proposal for the project, updating a 2022 plan, and requires U.S. Forest Service approval.
